name: SmartyParcel Delivery Tracker – Order Tracking & Shipment Tracking for WooCommerce
author: kirillbdev

sections.description:
Know where every order is, right inside WooCommerce. Keep all your tracking numbers in one place, watch delivery statuses update on their own and spot problem deliveries before your customers do.

With live tracking on, SmartyParcel Tracking keeps the delivery status of every WooCommerce order up to date. Add a tracking number to an order, and our shipment tracking solution follows the parcel with the carrier and updates its status in your store: in transit, available for pickup, delivered, exception. No more copying tracking numbers into carrier websites one by one.

Shipment tracking works with 1000+ carriers worldwide, including UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL, DPD, GLS, InPost, Royal Mail, Nova Poshta, Nova Post, Ukrposhta and Meest. One account, one plugin, every carrier you ship with.

Product Overview
Supported carriers
Documentation

Features

  • Add tracking numbers from the orders list or the order edit screen.
  • Add several numbers to one order for split and multi-package shipments.
  • Choose from 1000+ carriers.
  • See the carrier and tracking number of every shipment in the Tracking column.

Live tracking via SmartyParcel platform

  • Delivery statuses update automatically: in transit, available for pickup, delivered, exception and others.
  • See the current status of every shipment in the orders list.
  • Open the full tracking history on the order screen.
  • Follow shipments, delivery rate and exception rate on the dashboard.

How It Works

  1. Open an order and add a tracking number with its carrier.
  2. Connect the store to SmartyParcel to turn on live tracking.
  3. Delivery statuses appear in your orders list and update automatically.

Who It’s For

  • Dropshipping stores — follow parcels shipped with ePacket, Yanwen, YunExpress, 4PX and CJPacket.
  • Cross-border sellers — add a separate tracking number for each carrier a parcel travels with.
  • Stores with split shipments — keep several tracking numbers on one order, each with its own carrier and status.

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or greater
  • WooCommerce
  • PHP 8.0 or greater
  • MySQL 5.7 or greater is recommended

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of the plugin, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click Add New.

In the search field type “SmartyParcel Delivery Tracker” and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found it you can view details about it such as the point release, rating, and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”, then activate the plugin.

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading this plugin and uploading the smartyparcel-delivery-tracker folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your webserver via your favourite FTP application, then activating it in the Plugins menu. The WordPress documentation contains instructions on how to do this.

Updating

Automatic updates should work like a charm; as always though, ensure you backup your site just in case. Tracking numbers and the store connection are kept during updates.
sections.faq:
How do I add a tracking number to a WooCommerce order?

Click “Add tracking number” in the Tracking column of the orders list or in the “SmartyParcel Tracking” box on the order edit screen. Enter the number, choose the carrier and save.

Which carriers are supported?

1000+ carriers worldwide, including UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL, DPD, GLS, InPost, PostNord, Royal Mail, Nova Poshta, Nova Post, Ukrposhta and Meest. See the full list of supported carriers.

How are delivery statuses updated?

100% Automatically. SmartyParcel tracks the parcel with the carrier and sends every status change to your store, so order tracking in WooCommerce stays up to date without any manual action and without cron jobs on your server.

Is it free?

Yes, there is a free plan with a monthly tracking quota. Paid plans are only needed when you track more shipments than the free quota allows.

Can I add more than one tracking number to an order?

Yes. An order can have any number of tracking numbers, each with its own carrier and delivery status.

Can I use the plugin without a SmartyParcel account?

Yes. Tracking numbers can be added to orders without an account. To get automatic delivery statuses, connect the store to SmartyParcel: the account can be created during the connection, it takes a minute.

Can I use it for dropshipping?

Yes. The carrier list includes the logistics providers popular with dropshipping stores, such as ePacket, Yanwen, YunExpress, 4PX, CJPacket and China Post.

Will it slow down my store?

No. The plugin loads its scripts only on its own admin screens, so nothing is added to your storefront or checkout.

What if my carrier isn’t listed?

Check the full list of supported carriers. If your carrier is missing, ask for it on the plugin support forum.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (custom order tables) and with the legacy order storage.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

Tracking numbers and the store connection are kept in the database, so they are back when the plugin is installed again. Only temporary cached data is removed.
